question: What does Access’s Cascade Delete Related Records option do?
options: Delete every record in every table
Repeat the latest delete within the same table
Delete child records related to a deleted parent record
Delete only the parent while always retaining child records
referenceLabel: Microsoft Support — Create, edit, or delete an Access relationship
sourceNotes: Minor wording repair. When a parent/primary record is deleted, Access automatically deletes records that reference its primary key in related tables. Replaced “None of these” and shortened the choices while retaining the documented cascade behavior.
